What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[They're Tracking Us (V)]]: left, the image of [[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit 30816d1); right, the image of [[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit a41bae9). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
